links.outcome: Clinician trust and acceptance of prototype designed with continuous end-user engagement
links.effect: Physicians found the prototype design elegant and domain appropriate, and appreciated the explainability overlay and multi-image comparison. No comparator was used, so this is qualitative support only.
links.quote: Our work shows the importance and value of engaging end users prior to tool development.

unlisted_practices: Using a design thinking approach with a trust metric framework (domain representation, action ability, consistency) to design explainable clinical decision support
Using the NASSS framework to assess nonadoption, abandonment, scale-up, spread and sustainability during problem definition
Simplified explainability overlay showing only the patches that cumulatively explain 90% of the risk score, with a toggle option

screen.reason: Empirical human-centered study evaluating physician usability and trust of an explainable AI interface overlay for chest X-ray intensive care prognostic prediction.

primary.practice: explainable AI overlay design and user-centered co-design
